Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
This feels nice. Maybe we should've brought something to play with？
Something to play with... A frisbee or something like that？
Like that. I'd like to play badminton.
Badminton...
What's wrong？
(I'd never beat ▲高嶺＊＊▲, and it kind of reminds me of club practice...)
Takane
Lots of people walking dogs, huh？
It must be perfect for walks. It's wide, you can relax. Families can come too.
Hm？
Families... how lovely, right？ ...Hehe！
(She looks awfully happy... What's she thinking？)
Takane
A rainbow... Ah, there's one over there too.
Yeah. ...Hm？ There's one beyond that too.
Amazing. Maybe something good will happen？
I feel like it already has！
I got to see it with you... That alone makes me happy. Just kidding.
Takane
Would you call a place like this a power spot, I wonder？
Power spot？
A place where you can heal, or get energy.
Huh. Then my power spot is――
Next to me？ ...Just kidding.
Ah, hey！ No fair saying it first！
Got it right. Hehe！
Takane
Hey, let's stop to pray？
Yeah. What should I wish for～.
If all we do is ask for things, the gods might get tired, don't you think？
Then... maybe I'll give thanks for getting to come here with you today, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Please do▼ I'll copy you.
Takane
Did you know the god here is really playful？
Playful？
When it grants a wish, it whispers in your ear so only you can hear.
No way！ ...All right, let's find out.
(Please let me and ▲高嶺＊＊▲ stay close forever！)
That wish... I shall grant～.
Huh！？
Hm？
(...I'm hearing things, right？)
Takane
Today's movie was fun, wasn't it？
A hit？
A big hit▼ Ah, I want a program.
Me too. Let's go buy one！
Yes！
How was the movie today？
Takane
...It was fun in parts？
I see... I kind of get that.
You do？
Yeah. Like "Needs a little more effort."
Right, it doesn't get a gold star. Hehe.
Takane
...Hey, did you get it？ The story.
Not really... I can't figure out how to interpret it.
Maybe reading the program would help me understand a little.
Who knows... It feels like a waste to buy it.
Right... Hmm...
(That movie was a miss...)
Takane
How is it？ Feeling calmer？
I'm sorry, I...
Sad, heartbreaking, and then a happy ending. Of course the tears are going to flow.
It was really good...
(I'm glad we came to see it！)
Takane
Somehow I really feel like moving.
Haha, I get it, I get it. After a movie like that, right？
I want to try a roundhouse kick like the heroine's.
Huh！？
Hey, let's practi――
Okay, okay, let's go！
▲高嶺＊＊▲... sleepy？
Takane
I laughed so much I got tired.
Haha. But it's amazing they can make a movie that makes you laugh until you're tired.
The actors must have been laughing too, right？ On set.
I think so. Laughter saves the world！
Maybe so. Hehe！
How did you like the movie today？
Takane
The story was interesting. But...
When they explained fictional machines and materials that sound real, I couldn't follow at all...
Yeah, I get that.
If it were science fantasy instead of science fiction, I think I could follow it.
(...What would that be？)
Takane
Hey, your hand... is it okay？
No problem. A few nail marks will heal right away.
But... I squeezed really hard...
It's fine, that's why I picked a horror movie！
...Meanie！
Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲!? I was kidding！
Takane
That was fun.
Did it meet with your approval？
Yes▼ The story, the characters, everything. I want to see it again...
How about we buy the DVD when it comes out and watch it together？
Totally agree. I hope the DVD comes out soon？
The person next to us... Could they be a pro？
Takane
They're really good... Shall we ask？
Oh. You're excited about something unusual.
It's not like I want an autograph or anything, you know？
I just wondered if they might coach me a little. That's all.
(You're surprisingly shrewd, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
I'm beat！ Let's take a break！
Takane
Go ahead.
Huh？ What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Me... don't mind me, just relax？
...Why did it go in the gutter？ Maybe I'll start filming myself next time...
(▲高嶺＊＊▲... You're way too serious, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Takane
Hey, want to have a match？
...Hoho. You dare challenge me？
Hehe, stop it, who's that supposed to be？ A manga？
Enough talk, come at me！
A serious match, then？ Here I come！
(Hahaha, I'm gonna lose！)
Takane
Wow... my heart's still pounding.
From the show itself？ Or the atmosphere？
Both！ It was like an amusement park ride.
What a wonderful experience♪
Takane
The sound distortion was terrible, wasn't it？
Yeah. Bad tuning？
I paid more attention to that than to enjoying it...
Me too. It was good otherwise, what a waste...
Yes. I hope it's fixed next time we come？
Takane
Ahh... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you okay？
...Are you okay？
Yeah, well... let's go with something different next time.
Right. If we both end up like this, we can't enjoy it.
How was today？
Takane
It was fun. There were lots of songs I knew.
Good, good. Yeah, yeah.
Hehe, what？
Just thinking I'm glad we came here！
I'm glad I got to come here with you, too. Thank you.
Takane
My ears are really ringing...
That's kind of the whole point of rock, though？
It's so hot... I wish I could take my clothes off...
What!?
I wouldn't actually do that. Geez...
(I was surprised.)
Takane
*Sigh*.
How was it？
Jazz isn't just fun... how should I put it. It makes me melt.
It had a really grown-up atmosphere today.
Yes. ...It made me not want to go home.
Eh!?
Just kidding... or am I.
(Which is it!?)
That improvised back-and-forth was amazing.
Takane
It'd be fun to play with words like that...
What's up？ ...Don't tell me you came up with something？
Yes, but... I can't rattle it off like that.
Do it, do it！
No. If I could write it on paper... but then it wouldn't be funny, would it...
(I wish she'd do it～)
Takane
Voice actors are amazing. Good singers too.
Right！ ...But, you know.
Hm？
Doesn't one of them sound like you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Eh, really... I wonder. I can't tell myself.
(She totally does！)
Takane
Comedians have so many stories to pull from.
They must have their antennas up all the time. So they can turn anything into material.
Maybe I should follow their example and carry a notebook？
Let's write material and break into comedy together！ As a manzai duo！
You mean, a husband-and-wife act...
Hm？
Takane
I didn't know there were shows where the audience joins the play. It surprised me.
It's an interesting idea. The amateurs were impressive too.
Even when they got pulled up on stage, they were so composed, weren't they？
How about next time？ Your stage actress debut, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I'll pass. I'd definitely get stage fright and freeze up. You know that, right？
(Probably...)
Takane
Hey, what's this "History" button？
It shows the songs that were sung. Even the people who used this room before us.
...Really？ Then people can see ours too...
Well, yeah. Then let's show off with a lovey-dovey duet！
...No. "Donguri Korokoro," please. Then "Sakura Sakura" after that, okay？
(Nursery rhymes only!? ...Maybe I taught her too much.)
Takane
...Amazing.
Hm？ What is？
This menu item uses a whole loaf of bread, right？ With tons of ice cream and honey...
It's flashy, so maybe that kind of thing works at places like this. ...Want to order it？
Yes. Ah, no. But...
(She's so torn...)
Takane
Hey, can you keep singing？
Sure, but... isn't it boring with just me singing？
It's not boring. Your voice is really soothing...
You think...？
So, okay？ Please. Let me hear more？
(Wh-Why is this so embarrassing！)
Takane
You can see really far and clearly today.
My house is... no, that's too much to ask.
Where you used to live... is even more impossible, huh.
Huh？
Ah, sorry. I said something strange. Forget it？
Takane
Ah.
Hm？
No！ ...Look only at me？
What!? W-Wait, ▲高嶺＊＊▲!?
Don't turn around. The couple in that gondola over there is... um, kissing...
(This close, people outside might think the same of us...)
Takane
...Should I act a little more scared？
Huh？ Why？
Because... boys like girls they want to protect, right？
Not everyone. I like you just as you are, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Eh... geez, saying that all of a sudden... Okay.
What kind of haunted house would scare you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
...If you suddenly disappeared, like in a movie.
(I see... Okay！)
(Okay, just like this...)
Hey, you.
Whoa, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
No fooling around. It's dangerous.
(No good, huh...)
Takane
...Ah. Hey, looks like we'll be in the front car？
Really？ Awesome！
Feels like we got lucky.
Let's put our arms up, banzai！
Geez, that's dangerous. Hehe, but just a little, okay.
Announcement
We apologize. Due to strong winds, operation will be suspended after this run.
Takane
...So we're the last ones？
Lucky！ ...Is it？
...Is it？ It's a little scary. The thrill might be doubled, though.
...Want to skip it？
Hmm... Let's go！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is a real daredevil...)
Takane
Why do people like this kind of atmosphere, I wonder？
...In ancient times, fire was sacred. A flame in the darkness was humanity's hope... And so, people gather.
Just kidding. How was that？ Sounded legit？
...Hehe, maybe I'll believe it？
Please do, please do！
Geez, you're such a smooth talker.
Takane
Right now, it feels like any wish could come true...
Now's our chance！ Chant the spell！
Time, stop！
...It didn't work. Teehee♪
Didn't work, huh...
Then we'll have to come again, right？ Until it comes true. Promise.
Takane
Our dream time is almost over...
But even after the parade ends, we'll still be together.
...Yes, the rest of the dream is just for you and me...
...Oh no, that's kind of embarrassing.
I hear the slide here is crazy. How about it, Challenger Takane？
Takane
What's with that name？ I am interested. But...
A friend said it was so intense her swimsuit got a hole in it...
That's... it's fine！ I'll guard you perfectly！
...I'll pass after all. You'd be the one seeing, right, Mr. Guard？
Wait, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Takane
There's a couples-only time at the wave pool, apparently.
...Sounds like an intense event. Want to check it out anyway？
...Hmm... But... kind of...
Hmm...
(She's heading to the wave pool while thinking... so she is curious...)
Takane
Hey, look. There's a two-person float.
Oh yeah. "Two bodies, one soul！" Something like that？
Sounds kind of fun. What happens if we kick in different directions？
Let's try it. Okay, I'll go rent one！
Okay▼
Takane
I didn't know there really were places where you could see the stars like that.
Huh. Where can you see them？
Alaska. It was on TV the other day.
That's far！
So for now, I'll settle for here. Someday, I'll have the person I love take me there. Right？
(I'll do my best...)
...Hm？ Huh？
Takane
...Are you awake？
...Good morning. Was I asleep？
Yes, out cold. But don't worry. ...I got to hear all sorts of your secrets.
!? Um... what did I say？
Hmm, I wonder？
(Well, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ seems to be in a good mood... but what did I say...)
Takane
...Hey, why did we meet, I wonder？
Hm？
In this huge universe, why was it you, for me？
I've never thought about it. It just feels too obvious.
Right... maybe it is？ I can't imagine any other possibility anymore.
Takane
The vitality of plants is amazing, isn't it？
Basically, as long as they have water and light, they can live.
As for me... as long as I have you, I can live, I think？
Oh！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, look, a tasting corner！ All-you-can-eat fruit！
...Geez. You have to wait. Stay right here！
(I feel like a dog left tied up outside...)
Takane
Why are so many plant scientific names so long, I wonder？
Hmm. Because it makes them sound... more dignified？
They make them long for dignity？
Even though flowers don't need it, right？ It's human ego. Must be a pain for them.
There you go, making things up again. If you say it that confidently, I'll believe you.
(That'd be a problem. I'd better be careful not to make stuff up...)
Takane
An edible cactus tasting？
Ooh. ...Aw, reservations only. Too bad.
Does cactus have a texture like aloe, I wonder？
Ah, like the kind in yogurt？ Maybe.
We have a little cactus in our garden...
(Hmm？)
Was it fun？ ...Guess I didn't need to ask.
Takane
Why？
I can tell from your face.
Same goes for you. You've been smiling the whole time, you know？
Busted. Ah！ Uh-oh！ Fortune comes to those who smile！
Uh-oh, run... wait, we shouldn't run from that, geez. Hehe！
Did you have fun, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
Isn't it because I was with you...
So alone it'd be meh？
Well... Sorry to the people involved, but if it weren't a date with you, it'd be a bit...
So can I take that to mean I'm awesome？
You can▼ Just kidding.
Takane
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Are you okay？
Ah, sorry. I spaced out.
I wore you out, huh. I'm the one who should apologize.
Hey, let's move somewhere and rest a bit？
(Yeah, I'm tired too...)
I didn't fall asleep today！
Takane
Don't say that so loud.
Uh, sorry...
Very good. But you did well, didn't you？
There, there▼
(I'm embarrassed...)
Takane
It was so intense, wasn't it？
With fans cheering that passionately, of course.
I wonder if those girls have someone special too...
Huh！？
What's wrong？ You have a scary face...
(That's a taboo topic, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Takane
I wonder if it's hot on stage.
Probably. Especially for musicals.
Singing and dancing, right？ I could never match their stamina.
Not even you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I couldn't hold a candle to them.
(Well, that's right...)
Takane
Want to take a break, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...I will. Is that okay？
Of course. A fork in the forehead is a bit much, no matter what.
Ah, sorry！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Takane
Hey, how do the balls fly so far？ It seems hard enough just to hit them.
Home runs and stuff, it's like they ignore the laws of physics.
Hmm... That's right...
...Hey, have you ever been to a batting center？
(And... she's fired up！)
Takane
Hah... Wasn't that amazing？
Haha, it's rare to see you so excited, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Because, being able to make such wonderful clothes yourself...
That was definitely amazing. Real "princess dresses."
The prince outfits were wonderful too... If we could wear those and go to a castle together...
(She's totally a dreamy maiden...)
Takane
Ah, look？ The Ferris wheel.
Oh yeah. Then I bet you can see here from the Ferris wheel too.
Yes. We have to check.
We'll have to. When should we go？
Anytime, with you！
Takane
Ah. Hey, it's swaying.
Bridges really sway a lot...
Kind of fun, isn't it？ Like a trampoline.
And your jumping makes it shake even more, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...Farewell.
Ah, I take that back！
Takane
Without the city lights, the sea is pitch black, isn't it？
People long ago must've felt uneasy. With the roar of the sea and all.
...But if the person you love was next to you, like this.
...Yeah.
Hey, your hand. Can I have it？
Yeah...
Takane
Hey, what kind of Yakisoba do you think Tropical Yakisoba is？
Tropical yakisoba？ That's a thing？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you've got a sharp eye when it comes to food...
Yes. I have a sharp eye. When it comes to food. Sorry？
...I'll go get some.
Have a nice trip▼
(Me and my big mouth...！)
Takane
The sunlight is strong... I may have to apply sunscreen several times today.
Sounds like a pain. Want me to help？
Really？
Huh, you'll let me!?
...If you make such a lecherous face, it makes me not want to say yes, right？
(My apologies...)
Takane
Ah！？
Wh-What？
Over there, there's just a face sticking out... What's going on？
Ah！ That's, you know, someone buried in sand while they were sleeping. A prank, a prank.
There are pranks like that... Hmm...
(She's excited... I don't get what tickles ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
Takane
That doggy is full of energy, isn't it？
It's really going wild. Chasing the ball, splashing into the sea...
Ah, the ball...
Dog Owner
Sorry！
Oh, it's coming this way！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, return fire！
Hehe, alright！
Takane
The wind's a little cold, isn't it？
Want to hold hands？
Huh？
I'll link arms with you.
Takane
Amazing, the stars...
Since it's cold, it makes them even prettier, you know？
Yes...
Hey...
(No words needed right now... huh...)
Takane
How did it end up with such a flat body, I wonder...
Ah, there's a skeleton diagram.
The more I look, the less I think I'll understand...
(I understand why you say that...)
Takane
This little one is following us, isn't it？
Must be curious. Which of us is it more interested in, me or you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Want to find out？
Wh-Why, this little guy...！
It was stuck in the middle, all flustered, wasn't it？ Hehe▼
(Okay, that's cute...)
Takane
I want to hold a baby penguin.
Must be all round and fluffy.
I'll never get a chance to hold a real one...
It's not real, but there were plush ones over there. Want to go？
Yes, can we go look？ I'll make do with that for now.
(For now？)
Takane
Look, that penguin. It's reacting to the light. Cute▼
Maybe it looks like a fish to it.
...Ah, maybe. I hadn't thought that way...
Sorry, I was just making that up...
Right, the light reflects off the fish's body...
(Ah... I hope that's okay...)
...Tonight's dinner is... sashimi...
Takane
...Is what I'm NOT thinking, okay？
Hmm, too bad. I thought you were the same as me.
What！ Seriously？
Just kidding▼
(I got tricked...)
Takane
Have you heard of "night at the aquarium"？
They do that here？
No, a different aquarium. I saw it on the news. You stay overnight in sleeping bags in places like this.
Huh. They should do it here too.
Right. I bet it'd be wonderful.
(Better not bring up the "overnight" part...)
Takane
Were the dolphins here born at the aquarium, I wonder？
Probably？ Why？
If they came from the sea, I thought they might want to go back...
...I see.
Sorry, saying something strange all of a sudden. What's gotten into me？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is such a kind girl...)
Takane
It's crowded...
All right, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Shoulder ride！
Eh. Me, carrying you？
Pfft！ Why would it be that way！ Me, carrying you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Ah... right？ Oh no, what am I...
(That's so like ▲高嶺＊＊▲, or something...)
Takane
The wind feels kind of damp...
Ah, it's starting to rain！ Dash！
Eh, really？ Oh no！
...Sorry, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Just kidding！
Geez！
(It's her fault for looking so cute like that...)
It's so open here.
Takane
Yes. It makes me want to let loose.
Like how？
Um... singing loudly, maybe？
Nice. Then please, this week's number one is Manaka Takane with――
I won't sing.
(Darn.)
Takane
This area would look lovely from the sky.
From the sky... like a helicopter？ True...
I have to add it to the "Things We'll Do Together Someday" list.
Haha. When did you make that？ It must be pretty long by now.
Please stick with me till the end▼
Haha, likewise.
Takane
Sky Tower's Sky Ta-kun...
That's the mascot here, right？
Where did the "wer" in "Sky Tower" go, I wonder？
Maybe his little sister "Wer-chan" will show up eventually！
Hehe, can't wait！
(...She's not actually going to show up, right？)
Takane
If you set up a camera here and recorded from morning to night for a whole year...
You'd get something amazing.
The changing seasons, the city scenery changing...
Watching it would be tough... You'd have to fast-forward.
A whole year's worth, right？ Then spending time with you like this is more meaningful, I think？
Very meaningful！
Takane
"The crow is cawing, time to go home."
Did you hear a caw？
No. Look？ There's a crow down there.
Oh yeah. But it's not cawing, so it doesn't count.
Eh？
It's not cawing, so we don't have to go home！
Always with the excuses. I don't want to go home either, you know？
Takane
Wow, lots of new items.
Haha, your eyes are sparkling.
Sparkling▼ It's strange even to me, you know？ I was never interested before.
Behold the great power of the boyfriend...
Always getting carried away. No！
Takane
A man going into the fitting room...
This is a women's store, right... Ah, look, it's unisex. Oh.
But it's still a little girly, isn't it？
Yeah.
...Would it look good on you？
(Don't look at me with those hopeful eyes！)
Takane
Pretty stones...
Let's see. Hm？ Earrings for pierced ears.
...Does it hurt, I wonder？ I guess it does.
Probably.
I don't like pain, but... when I think about Papa...
(Right...)
Takane
Ah, a cute hair clip. It'd look good.
Oh？
On you▼
...Huh, me!?
Come on, try it on in front of the mirror？ I'm sure it'll be cute.
(Girls' "cute" is a mystery...)
Takane
What are you looking at？ "Remove all your dead skin with a circular massage after washing！"？
This... maybe I'll try it...
Stop！
It's no good？ That's fine, then. But why？
(Because she'd get carried away and end up damaging that flawless skin...)
These fake eyelashes are crazy. Do you really need to go this far？
Takane
Eye makeup alone can change a girl's look a lot... or so my friend says.
She insisted it's hard being expected to be girly as a matter of course.
...Same kind of feeling as being told "You're a guy, so of course you should work out," huh.
"Because you're this, you should be that"... I don't think anyone is happy to hear that...
(Maybe so...)
Takane
"From the shadow of the forest by the quiet lake♪"
"The cuckoo calls, 'Won't you wake up？'～♪"
That's where you're supposed to come in after me.
Oh right. Oops...
But singing along right away like that is impressive, isn't it？
(Barely passed？)
Takane
At night, if you looked at the sky from the middle of the lake... I bet you'd see the stars beautifully.
No city lights reach it, so maybe... but going out to the middle of a lake at night...
...Dangerous？ And it seems a little scary too.
Yeah... lakes do have that kind of vibe.
Right... so beautiful, it's like it pulls you in...
(I'm getting kind of scared.)
Takane
It's Lake Towano... so if there were a monster, would it be "Tossie"？
Tossie... It needs to sound scarier！
Then... TOSSIE！
Haha！ Why are you the one getting scary, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Ugh... never mind. Let's go？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is so cute.)
Takane
Eh... it stopped.
Broken down？ ...Hey, what would we do if we were stuck here for days？
...As long as you're here, I'll be fine.
Am I really that reliable...
...You're much, much more... wonderful and cool than you think, you know？ Really.
Whoa, looks like we're fine. Haha！
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you okay with seasickness？
Takane
This much is fine, you know？ Compared to a tour bus, it's nothing.
Then we can do a round-the-world cruise！
Will you take me？ Around the world？
...I'll do my best.
I'm looking forward to it▼
Takane
How far does the wake go, I wonder？
Forever... yeah... just like me and you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...Is this where I praise you for being so smooth？
Hmm, who knows？ That wasn't my best work.
So sloppy. Hehe！
Whoa, nice view！
Takane
Yes. It blows all my tiredness away.
Tiredness, tiredness, fly away！
You could use that for anything, couldn't you？
Bento, bento, I wanna eat！
Not yet▼
Ahh... this is so soothing...
Takane
Indeed it is... Just kidding.
The air's so fresh... a nap right here would feel great.
If you sleep here, the people climbing up will be startled, you know？
No good, huh.
Come on, one more push. Let's go？
Going downhill uses more muscles than going up, I guess... It's really tough.
Takane
What if my knees are all wobbly when I go to school？
Then I'll be your legs, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...Meaning you'll carry me on your back？
Yes！
Not at school... but here, maybe.
(On a mountain trail... might be impossible.)
I wonder who the chestnuts on this mountain belong to.
Takane
Why？
Because there are chestnuts lying all over the place. Look.
Really, so many... They belong to the landowner, right？
Probably. But people pick wild greens here, so maybe chestnuts are okay too.
...I'll have to look it up.
(The look in ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s eyes just changed...！)
Takane
The red maples are beautiful, but I like the yellow ginkgo too.
The color？ Not because you can get ginkgo nuts？
......They're delicious, right？ Ginkgo nut rice.
Oh！ Will you make it？
I won't make it for someone who treats me like a glutton.
Takane
...It's pretty steep...
The expert course might be a bit much...
......I'm going.
Are you sure？ You shouldn't push yourself.
...Sorry. Actually, can we go back？ Being stubborn in a place like this won't do any good.
(...Glad her competitive streak didn't kick in.)
Takane
I forgot to put on sunscreen.
